L-852T.use: taxiway edge in pavement, omni blue

L-804.use: elevated runway guard light, 2 yellow lamps alternately flashing

L-862.note: plus >=50 cd white omnidirectionally at all elevations to 15 deg (circling)

PAPI_LHA.use: PAPI lamp housing assembly (L-880), white above / red below a sharp transition
PAPI_LHA.note: contour extents read from AC 150/5345-28H Figure 3-1 (stadium shapes; +-0.25 deg reading error); V measured from the LHA aiming angle; LED PAPI light only within +-10.5 deg azimuth (JO 6850.2C 504b); night modes ~5 % and ~20 % of day (28H 3.3.8)

L-849E_REIL.note: tolerance +-50 %; omni style F: 5000/1500/300 cd at 2-10 deg, 60 fpm; SFO REIL style not published

L-810.use: red obstruction light, steady (or L-810(F) flashing 30 fpm)

MALS_PAR38.use: MALS steady-burning white (PAR-38 spot; 150PAR38/SP in Table 2-2); threshold PAR-56 300 W green
MALS_PAR38.note: intensity not published in the obtained FAA documents

SFL_flasher.rate: each flasher 2 flashes/s, sequence outermost -> threshold

intensity_steps.ALSF2_flasher_mapping: steady steps 4-5 -> flashers high, step 3 -> medium, steps 1-2 -> low

operation.src: jo7110 3-4-2..3-4-19 (tables transcribed); SFO tower facility directives may override (unknown)
operation.twilight_note: TBL 3-4-3: twilight = sunset to 30 min after sunset and 30 min before sunrise to sunrise
operation.runway_edge_on: sunset-sunrise for runways in use; sunrise-sunset when surface visibility < 2 SM (jo7110 3-4-10)
operation.als_on: sunset-sunrise when serving the landing runway (or approach to it); day when ceiling < 1000 ft or visibility <= 5 SM (jo7110 3-4-5)
operation.alsf2_vs_ssalr: operate ALSF-2 when prevailing visibility <= 3/4 SM or RVR <= 4000 ft (pilot request / controller); otherwise operate the SSALR mode (jo7110 3-4-9)
operation.sfl_on: visibility < 3 SM and instrument approaches to that runway, or on request; SFL cannot run when the ALS is off (jo7110 3-4-7)

reil_3step.on: when the associated runway lights are lighted

papi_5step.note: basic FAA PAPI is photo-electric: day mode when north-sky vertical illuminance rises to 50-60 fc, night below 25-35 fc, 45-75 s delay (AC 150/5345-28H 3.3.6)

operation.obstruction: sunset-sunrise if controls exist (jo7110 3-4-17); red lights switch on when north-sky illuminance falls below 60 fc, before 35 fc (AC 70/7460-1N 5.3)
operation.beacon: sunset-sunrise, and by day when ceiling or visibility below basic VFR (jo7110 3-4-18); NASR BCN_LGT_SKED = SS-SR
operation.rwsl: automatic intensity, operated continuously (jo7110 3-4-19); RELs light when high-speed traffic on runway or arrival within ~1 mi; THLs when runway occupied ahead of a departure (AIM 2-1-6)

beacon.position_note: NOT published in NASR/CS/AD; not in X-Plane or the cached OSM - open question

airport.lgt_sked_note: blank in NASR: no published schedule - lights per ATC (tower attended continuously, CS)
airport.wind_indicator_note: Y-L = lighted wind indicator (NASR); X-Plane has 8 windsocks, OSM 1 - positions not FAA-published

thl_rule.reference: runway end (start of takeoff roll) - inf; ac30j G.2.4 says "from the runway threshold"; for displaced-threshold ends the two readings differ by 300-640 ft

rel_rule.first: 2 ft before the hold marking (holding side)
rel_rule.lateral: 2 ft from taxiway CL, opposite side of the CL lights
rel_rule.next_to_last: 2 ft before the runway edge stripe
rel_rule.last: 2 ft beside the runway CL lights toward the taxiway

rwsl.rel_note: one entry per label on the FAA graphic, snapped to the nearest app hold (data/sfo_details.js) with the same taxiway and runway; which side/which of two parallel holds is lit is not resolvable from the graphic (dist_m shows the schematic offset)

runway_edge.colour: white; yellow in the caution zone (last 2000 ft or half length, whichever less) toward an instrument-approach end; red before a displaced threshold toward that approach
runway_edge.lateral: 2-10 ft outside full-strength pavement (10 ft recommended for jets)
runway_edge.intersections: HIRL on CAT III runways: L-850C in-pavement at intersections to keep spacing; others: in-pavement if gap > 400 ft

threshold_end.rule: 2 groups of 4 (instrument) on 10-ft centres, outermost in line with edge lights, 2-10 ft before threshold; green outward / red inward; displaced threshold: green wing bars outboard (inner light in line with edge lights), red end lights at the pavement end

stopway.rule: unidirectional red in the takeoff direction along the stopway edges; SFO: NASR/CS publish no stopway (blast pads only) - do not draw

rcl.colour: white; alternating red/white from 3000 to 1000 ft remaining; red last 1000 ft
rcl.displaced: <= 700 ft displaced area: blanked in the approach direction

tdz.rule: 2 rows of 3-light bars, 100-ft spacing, 100..3000 ft, inner light 36 ft from CL, 5-ft light spacing, toed 4 deg

alsf2.summary: bars every 100 ft to 2400 ft, 1000-ft 100-ft-wide crossbar, 500-ft barrettes, red side rows 100-900 ft in line with TDZ, green threshold bar, 15 SFL 1000-2400

ssalr.summary: mode of ALSF-2 for better weather: bars 200..1400 every 200 ft, 70-ft crossbar at 1000, threshold row on 10-ft centres, RAIL flashers 1600..2400

mals.summary: threshold row 10-ft centres (23 lights on 200-ft runway), 7 five-light bars 200..1400, 66-ft crossbar at 1000

malsf.summary: MALS + 3 SFL on the three outermost bars

papi.rule: 4 LHAs, left side, inboard LHA 50 ft +25/-0 from the edge, 30 ft +-1 apart, perpendicular to CL; sited so the visual path matches the published GPA/TCH (HG4: GPA source distance + 300 ft +50/-0); aiming +-30/10 arcmin (HG4 +-35/15)
papi.obstacle_surface: OCS from 300 ft in front of the PAPI at (3rd LHA aim - 1 deg), +-10 deg, 4 SM

reil.rule: 2 synchronised flashers, 40 ft from edge in line with threshold lights; unidirectional aimed 10 deg up / 15 deg toe-out (120 fpm) or omni (60 fpm)

taxiway_centreline.colour: green; lead-on/lead-off alternate green/yellow from runway CL (green first) to one light beyond the runway hold or ILS critical-area hold (ending yellow); crossing a runway: alternating
taxiway_centreline.lateral: <= 2 ft offset (2.5 ft to fixture CL), consistent side
taxiway_centreline.beam: straight: parallel to path; curves bidirectional parallel to tangent, unidirectional toed-in to meet CL at ~4 spacings
taxiway_centreline.sfo_status: SFO taxiway CL lights: NOT FAA-published per taxiway (X-Plane community data draws them widely) - unverified

taxiway_edge.colour: blue omni (L-861T elevated <= 14 in / L-852T inset)
taxiway_edge.spacing: straight > 200 ft: <= 200 ft; 100-200 ft sections: <= 100 ft; curves per Fig A-16 by radius; >= 3 lights on arcs > 30 deg

rgl_elevated.rule: pair of alternately flashing yellow lamps each side of the taxiway at the runway hold, 10-17 ft outside the taxiway edge, aimed at the cockpit 150-200 ft before the hold, 5-10 deg up; 45-50 flashes/min

rgl_in_pavement.rule: row across the full taxiway 2 ft on the holding side of the hold marking, 9 ft 10 in centres, facing away from the runway; even/odd alternate, each 30-32 flashes/min

stop_bar.rule: in-pavement red L-852S 2 ft on the holding side of the hold marking, 9 ft 10 in centres + elevated red L-862S each side <= 10 ft outside the edge; required below 600 RVR on lit taxiways to active runways
stop_bar.sfo_status: SFO SMGCS plan / low-visibility routes not found - unverified

clearance_bar.rule: 3 in-pavement yellow lights on 5-ft centres, 2 ft on the holding side of a taxiway/taxiway hold

beacon.rule: white/green alternating, 24-30 flashes/min (installation AC & AIM) / 22-26 fpm (equipment spec), beam centre 5 deg, mounted above surrounding obstructions

obstruction.rule: <= 150 ft AGL: steady red L-810 (double at top); > 150 ft: flashing red L-864 (2000 cd, 30 fpm) at top, L-810(F) flashing at intermediate levels (150-350 ft), all synchronised

apron_flood.src: ac5360 7.5 (current, no numbers; refers to IES RP-37-15); cancelled AC 150/5360-13 (1988) para 52 + Table 4-1
apron_flood.rule: mounted floodlights preferred, aimed/shielded against glare to pilots and ATC, overlapping sources from several directions; cancelled 1988 guidance: 5.0 fc (54 lx) at apron areas, 0.15 fc (1.6 lx) general AOA, mounts 25-50 ft at <= 200 ft spacing
apron_flood.sfo: DOF-surveyed poles 60-157 ft AGL around the aprons (high masts), see apron_masts

wind_cone.rule: lit wind cones required for night air-carrier ops; constant illumination independent of lighting step; SFO: NASR "Y-L" (lighted), positions not FAA-published
